name: Zheng-Dao Heavy Industries Containment Foam Launcher CFL-2 'Amber'
description: A pressurized launcher that deploys a binary chemical foam which expands on contact with air and hardens within 8 seconds into a rigid, heat-resistant polymer shell. A single burst can encase a human-sized target in a cocoon of hardened foam strong enough to resist small arms fire and capable of immobilizing even augmented individuals. The foam is porous enough to allow breathing through small air channels that form during expansion, though the experience of being rapidly encased in hardening chemical foam is described by test subjects as one of the most claustrophobic experiences imaginable. Zheng-Dao markets it as a non-lethal capture system, and it has become standard equipment for corporate extraction teams.
legality: Licensed — law enforcement and corporate security
specifications:
foam expansion: 40x volume in 3 seconds
hardening time: 8 seconds to full rigidity
compressive strength: 15 MPa when hardened
burst coverage: Sufficient to encase 1 human-sized target
tank capacity: 6 bursts per pressurized tank
effective range: 3-12 meters
weight: 9 kg loaded
dissolution: Proprietary solvent required, no natural degradation for 72+ hours
story_hooks: A target was found dead inside hardened Amber foam — the air channels failed to form properly in a defective batch, and the victim suffocated inside a rigid shell.
Someone has been encasing surveillance cameras across Tier 3 in containment foam, blinding entire security networks one node at a time — the foam is too hard to remove without damaging the equipment.

physical_description.visual_profile: A chunky, industrial launcher resembling a cross between a flamethrower and a caulking gun scaled up for heavy work. Squat and purposeful, with a pronounced forward tank assembly and reinforced shoulder stock. The silhouette reads 'chemical weapon' at a glance—intimidating and specialized.
physical_description.dimensions: 127 cm overall length, 28 cm width at tank, 18 cm height at grip. Barrel/nozzle extends 35 cm from body.
physical_description.weight_description: Hefty but balanced—9 kg loaded feels substantial but manageable when shouldered. Weight concentrates forward in the pressurized tank, requiring core strength to hold steady.
physical_description.primary_material: Reinforced polycarbonate tank body with welded steel frame and aluminum alloy nozzle assembly. Internal pressure vessel is hardened steel.
physical_description.finish: Matte industrial gunmetal with worn spots revealing bare steel beneath. Tank shows light chemical staining and residue marks from loading cycles. Grip area is scuffed from heavy use.
physical_description.color_scheme: Gunmetal gray primary with burnt amber/orange accents around the nozzle shroud and pressure gauges—hence the 'Amber' designation. Zheng-Dao logos in silver.
physical_description.grip_texture: Rubberized polymer grip with aggressive horizontal ridges for latex or synthetic gloves. Textured to prevent slipping when wet or covered in residual foam.
distinctive_features: Dual pressure gauges mounted on tank—one for system pressure, one for foam compound mix ratio
Wide, flared nozzle shroud with cooling fins to manage chemical heat during discharge
Exposed binary feed lines running from tank to nozzle in braided steel conduit
Shoulder brace with quick-release articulation for adjusting aim angle
Vent ports along tank sides with ceramic baffles to dissipate expansion heat
Manual pump primer handle on left side of tank for initializing binary mixture
Hardened foam splatter residue visible on lower barrel and shroud from field use
Scratch patterns on tank suggesting frequent repositioning in tactical harnesses
physical_description.manufacturer_markings: ZHENG-DAO HEAVY INDUSTRIES stamped in Mandarin and English on upper tank. Serial plate mounted on right side. 'CFL-2 AMBER' designation etched below nozzle. Pressure certification stamps in red. Warning labels in multiple languages on tank sides.
physical_description.condition_typical: Field-worn but maintained. Chemical residue and minor corrosion show regular use, but mechanism is clean and functional. Equipment of corporate security teams or law enforcement—used but not abused.
